name: B10-0445/2025 – § 78 – Am 8
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: 78. Draws attention to the growing crisis in the EU automotive sector, marked by excessive regulatory pressure, declining competitiveness, job losses and limited consumer demand for electric vehicles due to high prices and insufficient infrastructure; stresses that many EU citizens, particularly those in rural or low-income areas, are increasingly affected by transport exclusion and cannot afford to transition to costly alternatives; calls on the Commission to immediately stop policies that are destroying the EU automotive industry and, in close cooperation with the Member States, take urgent measures to restore its global competitiveness and rebuild the EU’s industrial strength;
